arrays: Pure numeric or boolean arrays, read with allow_pickle=False.
rgb: (N+1,1,256,256,3), uint8 HWC, pixels equal numbered PNGs
cube_pose: (N+1,1,7), diagnostic world xyz(m) and quaternion wxyz
model_inputs: Frozen qpos then qvel. Single state for article10; four 18D states for article11.
history: Oldest to newest, ending at t, repeat initial state on the left. Never includes t+1.
